description: An oscillator producing a smooth random waveform, with a cycle length you set and a rate at which the waveform mutates.

params.text: Sets the base frequency of the waveform, 0.18Hz to 5920Hz, with 0 giving C4 at 261.63Hz.
Sets the rate at which the waveform is randomly mutated; at 0 the waveform is fixed and repeats.
Sets the number of steps in one cycle of the waveform, 2 to 16.
Adds a layer at that multiple of the base frequency into the output.

inputs.text: Sets the base frequency, one volt per octave, added to the FREQ. knob.
Adds to the EVOL. knob at a tenth of its range per volt, raising the rate at which the waveform mutates.

outputs.text: The smooth random waveform, with any harmonic layers mixed in.

menu: Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
